conversations.name: cancelling
conversations.note: The follow-up moves to a different article with a near-identical wording.

turns.text: how long before do I have to cancel
turns.quote: A standard table booking can be cancelled free of charge up to four hours before the reservation time.

turns.text: what about for a private event
turns.oracle: how long before do I have to cancel a private event
turns.quote: A private event booking must be cancelled at least fourteen days before the event date for a full refund of the deposit.

turns.text: and if it is five days before
turns.oracle: what happens if I cancel a private event five days before
turns.quote: Cancelling with less than seven days' notice means the deposit is not refunded.

conversations.name: parking
conversations.note: A bare pronoun, then a turn that is already almost standalone.

turns.text: where can I park
turns.quote: There is paid street parking on Dundas, metered until 9pm on weekdays and until 6pm on Saturdays.

turns.text: is it free on sundays
turns.oracle: is street parking free on sundays
turns.quote: Sundays are free.

turns.text: how far is the subway
turns.oracle: how far is the subway station from the restaurant
turns.quote: the nearest subway station is about twelve minutes on foot.

conversations.name: accessibility
conversations.note: A contrast within one article: the answer is the opposite of turn 1's.

turns.text: is the dining room wheelchair accessible
turns.quote: The dining room is step-free from the street.

turns.text: what about the back room
turns.oracle: is the back room step free
turns.quote: The back room is reached by three steps and is not step-free,

turns.text: is there a washroom I can use
turns.oracle: is there an accessible washroom
turns.quote: There is an accessible washroom on the same floor as the dining room, with grab rails and a 150cm turning circle.

conversations.name: vegan
conversations.note: A plural pronoun whose antecedent is never named in the user's words.

turns.text: do you have vegan options
turns.quote: A separate vegan menu runs alongside the main menu and changes with the season.

turns.text: can they be made gluten free
turns.oracle: can vegan dishes be made gluten free
turns.quote: Most vegan dishes can be made gluten-free.

turns.text: do I have to tell you in advance
turns.oracle: do I have to tell you in advance that I eat vegan
turns.quote: You do not need to tell us in advance to eat vegan, but it helps for groups of eight or more so the kitchen can prepare enough.

conversations.name: hours
conversations.note: The topic crosses articles mid-conversation and never comes back.

turns.text: what time do you open
turns.quote: We serve dinner from 5pm to 10pm, seven days a week.

turns.text: is that the same on christmas day
turns.oracle: are you open on christmas day
turns.quote: We are closed on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day.

turns.text: when do you go back to normal
turns.oracle: when do you return to normal hours after the holidays
turns.quote: Regular dinner service resumes on 2 January.

conversations.name: deposit
conversations.note: 'it' refers two turns back, not to the turn before it.

turns.text: do I need a deposit for a table of eight
turns.quote: Standard tables of twelve or fewer do not require a deposit.

turns.text: what if there are twenty of us
turns.oracle: do I need a deposit for a booking of twenty guests
turns.quote: A deposit applies to private events and to any booking for more than twelve guests.

turns.text: how much is it
turns.oracle: how much is the private event deposit
turns.quote: From 1 March 2026 the private event deposit is a flat 200 CAD regardless of party size.

conversations.name: late
conversations.note: Three sections of one article, each needing the turn before it.

turns.text: how long do you hold my table if I am late
turns.quote: We hold your table for fifteen minutes past the booking time.

turns.text: what if I call ahead
turns.oracle: what if I call ahead to say I am running late
turns.quote: If we know you are coming we will usually hold the table longer,

turns.text: and if I am an hour late
turns.oracle: what happens if I arrive an hour late
turns.quote: If you arrive more than forty-five minutes after your booking time, the kitchen may not be able to serve the full menu,

conversations.name: large-groups
conversations.note: A follow-up that is grammatical on its own but underspecified.

turns.text: we are a group of twenty, can you seat us
turns.quote: Parties larger than twelve are handled by the events team as a private event.

turns.text: do we have to choose a set menu
turns.oracle: do large groups have to choose a set menu
turns.quote: Groups over sixteen choose from a set menu rather than ordering individually,

conversations.name: booking
conversations.note: Two different pronouns pointing at the same first turn.

turns.text: how do I book a table
turns.quote: You can book a table through the website, through the chat assistant, or by calling the restaurant directly during opening hours.

turns.text: do you need my card for that
turns.oracle: do you need my card details to hold a booking
turns.quote: We do not ask for card details to hold a regular table.

turns.text: how far ahead can I do it
turns.oracle: how far ahead can I book a table
turns.quote: Bookings open sixty days ahead for regular service and ninety days ahead for private events.

conversations.name: allergens
conversations.note: A negative pronoun — 'none' — which no rule here handles.

turns.text: I have a severe nut allergy, what should I do
turns.quote: For a severe allergy, please call ahead rather than relying on the chat assistant,

turns.text: can you guarantee there is none in the kitchen
turns.oracle: can you guarantee an allergen free kitchen
turns.quote: We cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment,

conversations.name: payment
conversations.note: A follow-up that is standalone but ambiguous with the deposit article.

turns.text: can we split the bill
turns.quote: We can split a bill up to six ways.

turns.text: is there a charge for a table of eight
turns.oracle: is there a service charge for a table of eight
turns.quote: A service charge of 18% is added automatically to tables of eight or more.

conversations.name: dress-code
conversations.note: The same fragment as the cancelling conversation, answered by a different article.

turns.text: is there a dress code
turns.quote: There is no dress code.

turns.text: what about at a private event
turns.oracle: is there a dress code at a private event
turns.quote: Hosts of private events sometimes set their own dress code for their guests.
